title: GitHub
description: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests and CI workflow runs for every connected GitHub App installation, plus a github.repo-events trigger that polls repos for new issues, pull requests and workflow runs. Installation tokens are issued by the host and never enter the add-on process.

descriptor.title: GitHub repo event
descriptor.description: Fires when a watched repository gets a new or updated issue, a new or updated pull request, or a new Actions workflow run. Polled, no webhook needed

sections.body: Connect a GitHub App installation in the connections section. The installation token is issued by the host on demand and never leaves the server. The github.repo-events trigger polls watched repositories: new issues and pull requests, updates to them, and new Actions workflow runs. Raw push events are not covered by polling; CI runs (workflow_runs) cover the push-to-build case. Conditional requests with ETags are used so polling does not consume the GitHub rate limit.
